definition: to wander slowly and take everything in
description: Inside a huge antiques warehouse with skylights, a young woman with a long braid, in a camel coat, white top and jeans, walks slowly down the middle aisle, looking up at a large crystal chandelier and then around her with a smile. On both sides stand stacks of old furniture: a wooden rocking horse high on a shelf, shutters, glass cases with stuffed birds, an old barber chair and rolled carpets. An old man reads a newspaper in an armchair and another man crouches by a crate.

de.answer: Sie geht an alten Möbeln vorbei.
de.question: Was macht die Frau gerade?

es.answer: Está pasando junto a muebles antiguos.
